title: Intrinsic Geometry of the Stock Market from Graph Ricci Flow
abstract: arXiv:2510.15942v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We use the discrete Ollivier-Ricci curvature with Ricci flow to examine the intrinsic geometry of financial markets through the empirical correlation graph of the NASDAQ-100 index. A key feature of our approach is that we begin from an entirely ORC-spherical initial graph --- one in which all Ollivier-Ricci curvatures are strictly positive --- in direct analogy with Hamilton's (1982) foundational setting of manifolds of positive Ricci curvature. What happens to such a graph under discrete Ricci flow is an open question: no prior algorithm was designed for or tested on graphs where all curvatures are initially positive and community structure is entirely latent. translated_title: 基于图里奇流的股票市场内在几何研究
translated_abstract: 我们利用离散Ollivier-Ricci曲率结合里奇流，通过NASDAQ-100指数的经验相关图来考察金融市场的内在几何。我们方法的一个关键特点是：从一个完全“ORC-球形”的初始图出发——即所有Ollivier-Ricci曲率均严格为正的图——这与Hamilton（1982）关于正Ricci曲率流形的基础性设定形成直接类比。这样的图在离散里奇流下会发生什么是一个悬而未决的问题：此前没有任何算法是针对所有曲率初始为正、且社区结构完全处于潜藏状态的图进行设计或测试的。我们提出了ARCUS（自适应里奇曲率无监督手术，Adaptive Ricci Curvature Unsupervised Surgery），对这一问题给出了经验性的回答：ORC-球形相关图的里奇流会发展出离散的“颈缩”奇点，曲率分布极化为两个截然分离的族群……
tldr: 该论文提出ARCUS算法，首次针对全正曲率的“ORC-球形”NASDAQ-100相关图开展离散里奇流实验，证明其会演化出离散颈缩奇点、使曲率分布极化为两个截然分离的族群，从而揭示了金融市场的内在几何结构。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ARCUS and empirically shows that discrete Ricci flow on an entirely ORC-spherical correlation graph of the NASDAQ-100 develops a discrete neckpinch singularity, polarizing the curvature distribution into two sharply separated populations and revealing the intrinsic geometry of financial markets.
